remarks:
Welcome to 5449 Emerald Avenue, a charming and spacious home nestled in the heart of the historic Point Chautauqua community. This inviting 5-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers plenty of room for gathering, relaxing, and creating lasting memories.

Nestled within the historic Point Chautauqua community, designed by renowned landscape architect Frederick Law Olmsted, this special neighborhood offers winding tree-lined streets and majestic mature trees that create a peaceful setting, making you feel as if you've escaped the everyday hustle and bustle. Residents enjoy a variety of amenities, including tennis and pickleball courts, a ball field, playground, swim area, social gatherings throughout the season, and boat docking opportunities on beautiful Chautauqua Lake.

Inside, you'll find three separate living spaces, providing flexibility for entertaining, quiet retreats, or hosting guests. The kitchen features a breakfast bar that opens to one of the living areas, creating a welcoming space for everyday living and conversation. Two dining areas make hosting gatherings and special occasions a breeze. Character abounds throughout the home, including two staircases leading to the second floor and multiple porches where you can enjoy your morning coffee, unwind with a book, or take in the peaceful surroundings.

The detached garage adds even more versatility, featuring guest accommodations above, complete with two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom, offering flexible space to suit a variety of needs.

Outside, the large yard provides ample space for outdoor activities, gardening, and enjoying the beauty of this historic community.

If you are seeking a vacation retreat, 5449 Emerald Avenue offers timeless charm, spacious living, and an unmatched sense of peace. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a piece of Point Chautauqua history.
